rules.requirement: Payment terms must not exceed 30 days
rules.description: The contract should require payment within 30 days.

rules.requirement: Termination notice must be at least 30 days
rules.description: Either party should provide at least 30 days written notice for termination.

rules.requirement: A liability cap must be explicitly defined
rules.description: The agreement should explicitly define a limitation of liability.

rules.requirement: An indemnification clause must be present
rules.description: The agreement should contain an indemnification provision.

rules.requirement: A confidentiality clause must be present
rules.description: The agreement should contain confidentiality obligations.

rules.requirement: IP ownership must be explicitly defined
rules.description: The agreement should clearly specify ownership of intellectual property.

rules.requirement: Data protection obligations must be defined
rules.description: The agreement should define applicable data protection responsibilities.
The agreement should specify the governing law and jurisdiction.
